findings.title: /admin/coupon (singular) shows SPA 404; Vue router only has /admin/coupons (plural)
findings.details: GET /admin/coupon returns the SPA shell which falls through to the Vue 'Page Non Trouvée' 404 component because the router only defines /admin/coupons (plural with admin.coupons.list child). Any bookmark, doc link, or external integration pointing at /admin/coupon will hit a 404. Admin sidebar currently links to /admin/coupons correctly, so this is silent for in-app users today. Recommend: add /admin/coupon redirect in Vue router or document canonical URL.

findings.title: Customers management surface not linked from admin sidebar
findings.details: Sidebar shows only 'Abonnés' → /admin/subscribers (newsletter email list). /admin/customers Vue route exists in the router bundle but is unreachable from the UI. /api/admin/customer returns 1 default 'Client passage' walking customer used by POS. Registered/loyalty customer management has no UI entrypoint. Operational rather than blocking — V1 Le Cayenne single-resto flows don't require registered customers since POS uses walking customer + Kiosk creates anonymous orders. V2 SaaS / loyalty work will need this surfaced.
findings.impact: feature discoverability for future loyalty work

findings.title: Multi-agent shared Playwright browser instance creates capture race conditions
findings.details: Running 3 parallel E2E missions (SYS-3 KDS, SYS-4 OSS+Cash, SYS-5 Admin) against a single Playwright browser tab caused frequent post-navigate redirect races. Page would land on intended URL then bounce to /admin/pos-v4, /admin/kitchen-display-system, /kiosk/idle, /admin/order-status-screen, /admin/cash-overview, or /logout during screenshot. Verification successfully pivoted to fetch-based API checks (Bearer token + x-api-key from window.foodkingConfig + vuex.auth.authToken) which are immune to navigation hijack. Recommend: in future per-system test waves, give each agent its own browser context (Playwright BrowserContext.new()) or run them sequentially.
findings.remediation: Use mcp__playwright BrowserContext isolation OR sequential mission scheduling

verdict.rationale: All 3 declared heals verified working (HEAL-02 audit trail hash_prefix + HEAL-3 EOD PDF + df0da680d ingredients web-guard). Dashboard renders cleanly. Items, Ingredients, Stock rupture, Cash overview, Coupons (plural), Settings/Entreprise, Subscribers all render with correct content. APIs return real data. Findings F-5-1 (coupon singular route 404) + F-5-2 (customers sidebar entry missing) are P2 discoverability issues, not blocking V1 Le Cayenne single-resto. F-5-3 is testing infrastructure (parallel agent browser contention) not product.
